verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's docs confirm on-call notification rules and readiness reports tied to responder notification configurations, mobile app for push, and escalation policies with schedules controlling who is notified; a hands-on account also confirms app-then-phone-call escalation in practice. However, no evidence explicitly enumerates SMS, phone call, and email as configurable per-channel notification rule options together, so full breadth of channel choice isn't directly documented in this pack. Missing for 10: explicit documentation naming SMS/email/push/phone as selectable channels with per-channel ordering, and independent confirmation of all four channel types working.
